18 只要秘密不外露，一切好说
知义在如情挽雪脸上来回扫视，这时开了口，让挽雪先出去，挽雪欲言又止的：“老爷……”声音很是凄楚。
知义眉毛微皱，轻声道：“你先下去吧。让丫头上点儿药。”
挽雪心有不甘，却也不敢再说什么，福了身子后便离去了，如情待挽雪一走，便向知义解释：“哥哥，我真的不是故意的，我只是做了个噩梦而已。”
知义拉了个凳子放到如情床前，大马金刀地坐下，笑道：“我知道，如今就你我兄妹二人，你就不必再向我藏着掖着了，说吧，刚才究竟做了什么梦？肯定不会是梦到靼鞑。”
如情低头，很是不好意思，“可不可以不说呀。”这要她乍个说呢？太难为情了，也不好解释的。
知义倒也没有穷追，道：“行！不过，你总得与我说说，李骁溺水，你用了什么法子救的他？”
如情傻眼，吱吱唔唔地道：“也没什么呀，就是，按他的肚子，再按他的胸膛，就，就这样把他给按醒的。”
知义蹙眉，“一般溺水之人是不容易救活的。你倒好，居然神奇的把他给救了。我问李骁的护卫，他们吱吱唔唔的说不清楚，只说是你救的。问你的丫头，一个个吓得活像受惊的小白兔似的，结结巴巴的半天也说不清楚。我很想知道，你究竟是如何施救的？”
如情一个头大，也跟着结巴道：“哥哥，我可不可以不说呀？”
知义瞪她。
如情受不得他这张棺材脸，捎捎头，撒娇道：“哥哥，妹妹求你嘛，别再追问了，这是个秘密，任何人都不能说的。”
知义看她半晌，如情又继续撒娇，他微微叹气，只得作罢。“刚才梦见谁了？”
“李骁！”如情捂着双唇，懊恼无比，忍不住拿了枕头扔他，“哥哥你使诈。”
知义接过枕头，笑问：“他在梦里又如何惹你了？连贱骨头说出口了。”
如情眼珠子转了几转，道：“他很可恶嘛，仗着救过我一命，大说我的坏话。所以我就忍不住打了他，没想到，却打到了挽雪嫂子。哥哥，我真不是故意的。”
知义表示知道，“刚才我去了李骁那一趟，也送了些礼以表谢意。他也回赠了我两瓶雪肤金创药，说是给你用的，效果奇好。”说着从怀里掏了两个红花瓷瓶，交给如情，“等下让丫头们给你上药，李骁说这是皇上御赐的圣物，治疗外伤极是有效。三天功夫就能愈合，并且不留疤痕。”
如情从被子里伸出雪白耦臂，飞快地接过，然后迅速又把自己藏起来。她这个动作也只是无意识的，但对知义来说，也才明白过来，身为兄长在妹妹闺房里极是不妥当的，然后立马起身告辞。
如情养伤期间，极是无聊，不过幸好包打听的玲珑时常与她说了最近大同的八卦事儿，倒也不至于无聊到数苍蝇。
李骁受马贼袭击，在山西地界引发了大地震，因为李骁马上就要回京复命，却在临走前几天被马贼袭击，实在是猖獗目中无人。一来怕李骁回京后在皇帝面前说他们治理不力，二来也怕李骁怪罪下来，他们也担当不起，是以，最后以代王及巡抚为首的高级将官，开始了清匪行动。

再来，李骁回去后，也受了场风寒，不过代王府的御医去看过后，开了几贴药，吃了也没啥大碍了。最近又生龙活虎起来。
如晴闻得此事，好一通鄙视，亏他还是练武之人呢？同样落水，她至今仍是生龙活虎，偏他居然还病倒了，果真是娇贵的王爷呀。
最后，李骁还特意来了将军府一躺，知义在前头接待，听说是特意来感谢如情并进行慰问的。可惜如情是深闺中的女子，不宜见客，李骁也不强求，只是留下好些补品来。
紧接着，李骁离京了，因为前些日子与马贼作战，狠是损失了好些护卫。所以知义亲自派了将士，把李骁送出山西地界，并一路命人护航回京。
如情长舒了口气，拍拍胸脯，“很好，总算回去了。”这回她不怕秘密被泄露了。只要李骁身边的护卫不说去，应该不会有大问题的。

18 As long as the secret is not exposed, everything is easy to talk about
Zhiyi glanced back and forth at Ruqing Wanxue's face, and then opened his mouth to let Wanxue go out first. Wanxue hesitated to speak: "Master..." his voice was very sad.
Zhiyi frowned slightly and said softly: "You go down first. Give the girl some medicine."
Wan Xue was unwilling to do so, but did not dare to say anything more. After recuperating, she left. As soon as Wan Xue left, she explained to Zhiyi: "Brother, I really didn't mean it. I just had a nightmare."
Zhiyi pulled up a stool and put it in front of Ruqing's bed, sat down with a golden sword, and said with a smile: "I know, now that we are the two brothers and sisters, you don't have to hide from me anymore. Tell me, what did you dream about just now? It definitely wasn't about Tartar."
Ruqing lowered her head, feeling very embarrassed, "Can you not say it?" Should she say it first? It's so embarrassing and hard to explain.
Zhiyi did not pursue him and said, "Okay! But you have to tell me that Li Xiao was drowning. What method did you use to save him?"
Ruqing was dumbfounded and said: "It's nothing. I just pressed his belly, then his chest, and that's how I woke him up."
Zhiyi frowned, "It's usually not easy to save a drowning person. Fortunately for you, you miraculously saved him. I asked Li Xiao's guards, and they couldn't tell clearly. They just said that you saved him. When I asked your girls, they were all frightened like frightened little white rabbits. They stammered for a long time and couldn't explain clearly. I really want to know, how did you save him?"
Ruqing, who had a big head, also stammered: "Brother, can I not tell you?"
Zhiyi glared at her.
Ruqing couldn't stand his coffin face, so she tilted her head and said coquettishly: "Brother, sister, please, please stop asking. This is a secret that no one can tell."
Zhiyi looked at her for a long time, Ruqing continued to act coquettishly, he sighed slightly and had to give up. "Who did you dream about just now?"
"Li Xiao!" Ruqing covered her lips, feeling extremely annoyed and couldn't help but throw a pillow at him, "Brother, you are cheating."
Zhiyi took the pillow and asked with a smile: "How did he mess with you in the dream? He even said it out loud."
Ruqing rolled her eyes a few times and said, "He is very hateful. Just because he saved my life, he spoke ill of me. So I couldn't help but beat him. Unexpectedly, I hit Sister-in-law Wanxue. Brother, I really didn't mean it."
Zhiyi said he knew, "I went to Li Xiao's place just now and gave some gifts to express my gratitude. He also gave me two bottles of snow-skinned medicine in return, saying they were for you and the effect was amazing." He took out two red flower porcelain bottles from his arms and handed them to Ruqing, "Let the girls apply the medicine to you later. Li Xiao said this is a sacred thing given by the emperor and is very effective in treating trauma. It will heal in three days without leaving any scars."
Ruqing stretched out her snow-white arms from the quilt, quickly took it, and then quickly hid it again. Her action was only unconscious, but Zhiyi finally understood that it was extremely inappropriate for an elder brother to be in his sister's boudoir, and he immediately stood up to leave.
Ruqing was extremely bored while she was recuperating from her injuries, but fortunately, Linglong, who was inquiring, often told her the recent gossip about Datong, so she wasn't so bored that she counted flies.
Li Xiao was attacked by horse thieves, causing a major earthquake in Shanxi. Because Li Xiao was about to return to Beijing to resume his duties, he was attacked by horse thieves a few days before leaving. He was really rampant and arrogant. Firstly, they were afraid that Li Xiao would accuse them in front of the emperor of not being able to govern well when he returned to Beijing. Secondly, they were also afraid that Li Xiao would be blamed and they couldn't afford it. Therefore, senior generals headed by the acting king and the governor finally started an operation to purge the bandits.
Next, after Li Xiao returned, he also suffered from a cold, but after being visited by the royal doctor of the Prince's Palace, he was prescribed a few pills, and after taking them, there was no serious problem. Recently it has become lively again.
Ru Qing heard thisHe is so despised, but he is still a martial arts practitioner? She also fell into the water, but she is still alive and well, but he actually fell ill. He is really a delicate prince.
Finally, Li Xiao came to the General's Mansion to lie down, and Zhiyi was waiting in front to receive him. He heard that he came specifically to thank Ruqing and express his condolences. It's a pity that Ruqing is a woman in a deep boudoir and is not suitable for seeing guests. Li Xiao doesn't force her, but just leaves a lot of supplements.
Immediately afterwards, Li Xiao left the capital because he had lost many of his guards in the battle with horse thieves a few days ago. So Zhiyi personally sent soldiers to send Li Xiao out of Shanxi and ordered people to escort him all the way back to Beijing.
Ruqing breathed a long sigh of relief and patted her chest, "Very good, I'm finally back." This time she wasn't afraid that her secret would be leaked. As long as the guards around Li Xiao don't tell him to go, there shouldn't be any big problem.
